findings: Unused import STATUS_META — imported from @/lib/program but never referenced in the page. Remove it.
earnings deposit type is excluded from both breakdown tiles (parentDeps and govDeps), so the two sub-tiles will sum to less than the main balance tile on any account with earned returns.

getApplicationDetail skips ensureSeedData(), unlike every other public service function. Safe on this page due to call order, but fragile — any future caller that doesn't first invoke a seeded function will hit a missing-table error.

Rejected pipeline status renders as step 1 ('Submitted — Current') because PIPELINE_STEPS has no 'rejected' entry and findIndex returns -1, clamped to 0. A rejected guardian sees a misleading pipeline.

Verification dot uses color as sole state indicator: the neutral 'not started' dot (bg-gov-base-light, #dfe1e2) on a white card has ~1.3:1 contrast ratio, below WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 threshold. Switch to bg-gov-base or add a border.
